document.title: Certain Government Payments
document.issued_by: a federal, state or local government unit

boxes.label: State or local income tax refunds, credits, or offsets
Box 2 amount is for tax year
If checked, box 2 is trade or business income

boxes.notes: The unnumbered blank box beside box 9. Recipient instruction for box 2: 'the payer may include interest of less than $600 in the blank box next to box 9 on Form 1099-G.' The face prints no caption, so the label is empty.

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed above the issuer's block on every copy. A corrected form replaces one furnished earlier; its figures are the ones to use, never counted beside the earlier form's.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed on Copy A (the issuer's filing copy) and the state copy; the recipient's Copy B does not print it.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. An account or other unique number the issuer assigned; identification only, never a figure.

document.notes: The revision in force for tax year 2025 is Rev. March 2024; irs-prior/f1099g--2025.pdf returns 404. DO NOT take the box numbering from irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1099g.pdf, which serves Rev. December 2026: that revision inserts a new box 10 'Family leave benefits' and renumbers the state boxes to 11a/11b/12. On the TY2025 form the state boxes are 10a, 10b and 11 and there is no family leave box. Confirmed against Publication 1179 (Rev. Proc. 2025-22), whose exhibit prints 'Form 1099-G (Rev. 3-2024)'. Parser note: the revision string is NOT on page 1 of this PDF - page 1 is the 'Copy A ... informational purposes only' cover and the form face is page 2.
